text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"གཟུགས་རབ་ཏུ་དབྱེ་བའི་བརྟགས་པ་རྣམ་པ་དུ་ཞིག་ཏུ་རྟོགས་པར་བགྱི་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ལ་སོགས་པ་ཞུས་སོ། །","english":"it was then asked: \"Blessed One, how many types of imagined classifications of form should a Bodhisattva... understand?\"","kind":"role","why":"The source says the Bodhisattva (Maitreya) asked the question, but the English implies a passive voice or external agent.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}
